message.content: Rowan finds the intriguing aspect of Jaime Lannister's storyline to be his character transformation and the pivotal moments in his journey, particularly his bond with Brienne of Tarth. This bond is noted for bringing out his honor and complexity, as evidenced by his evolving relationship with Cersei and the pivotal moments in his narrative, such as when he saves Brienne in the battle and when he confronts Cersei in season 7. Rowan is particularly interested in these transformations and the contrasts between Jaime's initial self-centered persona and his eventual growth and depth.
